title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: Split Down the Middle, But Looking Ahead
summary: We went 2-2 on Sep 30, and here's what the model sees for tomorrow's Braves matchup

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About .500 Days

September 30th gave us one of those perfectly balanced days—2 wins, 2 losses, right down the middle at 50%. Not the fireworks we were hoping for, but here's what I love about days like this: they remind us that baseball is beautifully unpredictable, and our model is learning every single pitch.

## The Tale of Two Halves

Our model had a story to tell yesterday. The Braves and Astros—both at 62% confidence—didn't go our way. Sometimes the favorites just don't show up, and that's baseball. But then the Yankees and Padres came through exactly when we called it, with the Padres pick feeling especially sweet at that 62% mark.

## Tomorrow's Story: Braves Get Another Shot

Here's where it gets interesting. The Phillies and Braves are running it back on October 1st, and our model is giving Atlanta another chance to prove themselves. At 61% confidence, we're backing the Braves at home again.

The pitching matchup features Zack Wheeler taking the mound for Philadelphia against Brent Suter for Atlanta. Wheeler's a proven ace, but our model sees something in the Braves' favor—maybe it's the home field advantage, maybe it's the overall team dynamics, or maybe it's just that Atlanta wants redemption after yesterday.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 1 Top Pick
content.sub: 61% win probability vs Phillies · Brent Suter on the mound

content.value:
## The Human Element

What I love about back-to-back matchups like this is the storyline. The Braves have something to prove after yesterday's miss. These teams know each other intimately at this point in the season. Wheeler versus Suter is a David and Goliath story in some ways—the established ace against the crafty veteran.

Our model crunches the numbers, but the heart of baseball beats in these moments. Will Atlanta bounce back? Can the Phillies sweep the series? That's why we keep coming back.

**Tomorrow's slate drops at first pitch. Let's see if the Braves can deliver what our model believes they can.**

author: Hana
